test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The average weight of 14 students of a class is 20 kg. If a student leaves the class, the average weight of the class drops by 2 kg. Find the weight of the student (in kg) who left the class.
solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of 14 students of a class is 20 kg.

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/No. of elements

**Calculation:**

Total weight of 14 students = 14 × 20

⇒ 280 kg

After a student left the class total weight of the class = (20 - 2) × 13

⇒ 18 × 13 = 234 kg

So, the weight of the 14th student who left the class was = 280 - 234

⇒ 46 kg

**∴ The weight of the student (in kg) who left the class is 46.**
